project_type: Full-stack monorepo: FastAPI backend, React/Vite frontend, Cloudflare Edge Worker
build_system: pnpm workspace monorepo, pip requirements.txt for backend, wrangler for edge
test_framework: vitest for frontend, pytest for backend (but tests are minimal)
verification_instructions: 1. Check backend starts without import errors. 2. Frontend builds without errors. 3. Edge worker TypeScript compiles.
setup_instructions: npm install in root, pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. MongoDB not available for live testing but can validate code structure. No docker daemon needed.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns. Beanie ODM for MongoDB models. React Query hooks for data fetching. Tailwind CSS + inline styles for UI.
key_patterns: - R2 assets served via edge worker at /assets/<key> path. - Content models in apps/backend/app/models/content.py use Beanie Document. - Library page uses React Query hooks from useContent.jsx. - Library sections use lazy-loaded components (CmsDocsSection, CmsPostsGrid). - API endpoints use FastAPI APIRouter at prefix /api/v1/content. - Frontend cards follow CmsDocCard/CmsPostCard pattern (link, title, metadata).
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/models/ - Beanie document models. apps/backend/app/api/v1/ - FastAPI route modules. apps/frontend/src/pages/ - React page components. apps/frontend/src/pages/library/ - Library sub-components. apps/frontend/src/hooks/ - React Query hooks. apps/edge/src/ - Cloudflare Worker entry + routes.
